# Erdos.p272 — Erdős problem 272

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/272
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/272.lean`, theorem `erdos_272.variants.szabo_strong`, AMS 5).

Szabo asks whether the maximal $t$ is given by
$$
  \frac{N^2}{2} + O(N)
$$

## Statement
(fun N ↦ (maxArithInterCard N - N ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun N : ℕ ↦ (N : ℝ)
